title: Friendship
definition: Biblical friendship is a relationship of mutual encouragement, loyalty, honesty, wisdom, love, and spiritual growth.
summary: Faithful friends strengthen one another, speak truth in love, remain present in hardship, and encourage one another toward God.
christFocus: Jesus calls His followers friends and demonstrates perfect friendship through sacrificial love.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Faithful friends strengthen one another, speak truth in love, remain present in hardship, and encourage one another toward God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
